article.subtitle: retool.com
article.linkLabel: Open article: Retool Blog | When anyone can build apps, governance becomes the constraint by retool.com

posts.content:
Three questions tell you whether you're actually governing AI, or just have a policy that says you do:

Who's acting: human, agent-as-user, or agent-as-service?
What can they reach: is that access scoped, or broad by default?
Can you stay in control: deterministic rules, audit trails, bounded spend?

If those answers come easily, governance is working. If they don't, you've found your roadmap.

Eytan Lerba, who leads Product for Governance & Infrastructure at Retool, broke it down in a new blog post → https://lnkd.in/dnh9TuUz
